sources.title: Varkouhi and Ribeiro: Bimineralic Middle Triassic ooids from Hydra Island: Diagenetic pathways and implications for ancient seawater geochemistry
sources.notes: Full primary HTML read. Oncoid subsection supports irregular roughly concentric, partly overlapping laminae around lithoclastic/sometimes bioclastic nuclei, spherical and asymmetric forms. Reported Hydra1.8–4.1mm sizes are NOT imported into this generic cm-scale pedagogical bed. Precise mediating biota unclear after diagenesis. Inventory title corrected; article principally about ooids but relevant oncoid subsection distinguished.
